mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances during periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of earnings downgrades and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL is above 220.0, it indicates a high-pressure monetary policy regime that suppresses inflation but also raises discount rates, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a 3-month decline, combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST), signals a recovery in private demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 0.5% MoM after 3 consecutive months of decline AND HOUST > 520.0
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand for two consecutive months, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 130000 AND UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) following two consecutive quarters of growth signals a potential economic slowdown, which increases the risk of earnings revisions downward and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines > 0.5% QoQ after 2 consecutive QoQ growth periods
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
